- `PluginSummary.auth_policy`: `Option<PluginAuthPolicy>` → `PluginAuthPolicy`

- `PluginSummary` construction now uses `plugin.install_policy.into()` / `plugin.auth_policy.into()` (direct conversion, no `Option::map`)
- `PluginInstallResponse` construction uses `result.auth_policy.into()`

- `core/src/plugins/marketplace.rs`: `MarketplacePluginSummary` and `ResolvedMarketplacePlugin` fields made non-optional; added `Default` derives to `MarketplacePluginInstallPolicy` (default `Available`) and `MarketplacePluginAuthPolicy` (default `OnUse`); construction sites now apply `unwrap_or_default()` when reading the marketplace JSON (where these fields remain optional).
